text: {"name":"update_delta_and_flag_entries","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Computes and stores a signed-byte delta from fields at offsets 420 and 464, applies the offset-110 limit or sentinel behavior, flags linked entries when applicable, and returns the type_get result for the object at offset 72.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"result":"state","i":"entry","v2":"delta_limit","v3":"delta"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":72,"meaning":"Object passed to type_get after delta processing"},{"offset":109,"meaning":"Stored signed-byte delta"},{"offset":110,"meaning":"Signed delta limit; 127 is a sentinel"},{"offset":240,"meaning":"Head pointer of a linked list of entries"},{"offset":350,"meaning":"Entry flag byte; bit 0x10 is set"},{"offset":420,"meaning":"First unsigned byte operand in the delta calculation"},{"offset":464,"meaning":"Second unsigned byte operand subtracted from the first"}]}
